signature.name: VTask.bliminf
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] -> (u : β → α) -> (f : Filter β) -> (p : β → Prop) -> α

conventions.statement: When the bounding predicate is identically False, VTask.bliminf u f (fun _ => False) = ⊤, because the implication (False → a ≤ u x) is vacuously true for every a, making the supremum range over all of α.

conventions.point: Empty qualifying set in a ConditionallyCompleteLattice
conventions.statement: If the set {a | ∀ᶠ x in f, p x → a ≤ u x} is empty (possible in a mere ConditionallyCompleteLattice), the value of VTask.bliminf is sSup ∅, which is conventionally a junk value and not guaranteed to equal ⊥.
conventions.note: This is a lattice-completeness subtlety; in a CompleteLattice sSup ∅ = ⊥.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (u : β → α) (f g : Filter β) (p : β → Prop), f ≤ g → VTask.bliminf u g p ≤ VTask.bliminf u f p

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (u : β → α) (f : Filter β) (p q : β → Prop), (∀ x, p x → q x) → VTask.bliminf u f q ≤ VTask.bliminf u f p

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (u : β → α) (f : Filter β) (p : β → Prop), VTask.bliminf u f p ⊓ VTask.bliminf u f (fun x => ¬p x) = Filter.liminf u f
